description: The bar chart illustrates performance metrics for three Text-to-SQL methods across the evaluation measures Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The horizontal axis contains the metric categories labeled “Recall,” “Precision,” and “F1 Score,” arranged left to right, while the vertical axis is a numeric scale (linear) with labeled ticks at 40, 60, 80, and 100, indicating values in the approximate range 40–100 (no explicit unit shown). Each metric category contains a grouped set of three vertical bars corresponding to the legend: a light blue bar for “(zero-shot),” a darker blue bar for “TA-SQL (zero-shot),” and a light green bar for “DIN-SQL (few-shot),” with exact values printed above each bar. For Recall, the light blue bar is 63.58, the dark blue TA-SQL bar is 71.90, and the light green DIN-SQL bar is 72.29. For Precision, the light blue bar is 88.89, the dark blue TA-SQL bar is 91.24, and the light green DIN-SQL bar is 92.31. For F1 Score, the light blue bar is 75.34, the dark blue TA-SQL bar is 80.40, and the light green DIN-SQL bar is 81.08. The bars are grouped by metric rather than sorted by value, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the numeric labels above the bars.
